facts.fact: General Notice No. 79 of 2025, under the Standards and Quality Act, 2023 (Act No. 16 of 2023), designated 19 new Eswatini National Standards, including the National Addressing Standard Part 1 (SZNS ISO 19160-1:2015) and Part 2 (SZNS ISO 19160-2:2022) on address classes and assigning and maintaining addresses; the article names no standards body and gives the publication date as the date.

note: Document names no standards body and no certifier; the other designated standards (electricity, fuel, LPG, climate adaptation) are non-IT and give nothing.

systems.system: SZNS ISO 9001 certification of the Eswatini Revenue Service

note: ESWASA announced the Eswatini Revenue Service certified to SZNS ISO 9001, a quality-management standard, not an IT or data standard, so class other and no fact.

systems.owner: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade; implemented by Eswatini Standards Authority (ESWASA) with SEDCO

note: The Ingelo scheme is a product-quality certification scheme for MSME cottage factories (jam, dried fruits), not an IT or data standard; the document states no law establishing the body and no IT or data standard.

facts.fact: The Standards and Quality Act (Act 10 of 2003), assented to on 8 November 2001 with commencement to be proclaimed by the Minister, establishes the Eswatini Standards Authority as a body corporate with power to draft, issue, amend and withdraw Eswatini standards.

systems.owner: Government of Eswatini (Ministry responsible for Standards and Quality assurance)

note: The Act names no IT or data standard and no certification against one; its certification marks and licences cover commodities generally.
Authority named but no standard issued or certification stated; no law establishing it mentioned.

facts.fact: The release describes ESWASA as Eswatini's national standards body, established under the Standards and Quality Act of 2003, amended in 2023.
ISO's member page says the Eswatini national standards body opened on 2 April 2007 and has a standards development unit and information centre in operation.

note: International committee roster; no national standard or certification stated.
Ingelo certifies MSMEs, not against an information technology or data standard.

facts.fact: ESWASA turned ISO 19160-1:2015 (address information) into the gazetted national standard SZNS ISO 19160, launched on 16 July 2026.
